from pathlib import Path
import gzip,hashlib,json,subprocess,tarfile
ROOT=Path.cwd();DEST=ROOT/'docs/evidence/milestone-5/broad-fix-1';DATA=Path('/private/tmp/spl-toolkit-m5-broad-fix-1')
sha=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
v=json.loads((DEST/'verification.json').read_text())
for name,want in v['evidence_artifacts'].items():
    data=(DEST/name).read_bytes();assert sha(data)==want['sha256'];assert len(data)==want['bytes']
with tarfile.open(DEST/'execution-records.tar.gz') as archive:
    found={m.name:sha(archive.extractfile(m).read()) for m in archive.getmembers() if m.isfile()}
assert found==v['execution_archive_manifest']
for name,original in [('go-transport.json.gz','go-transport.json'),('category-amended-transport-expectation.json.gz','category-amended-transport-expectation.json'),('source-spl2.json.gz','source-spl2-evidence.json'),('source-schema.json.gz','source-schema-evidence.json'),('package.json.gz','package-evidence.json')]:
    assert gzip.decompress((DEST/name).read_bytes())==(DATA/original).read_bytes()
transport=json.loads(gzip.decompress((DEST/'go-transport.json.gz').read_bytes()))
expected=json.loads(gzip.decompress((DEST/'category-amended-transport-expectation.json.gz').read_bytes()))
assert transport['reports']==expected['reports']
reports={x['id']:x['report'] for x in transport['reports']};assert len(reports)==1714
source=json.loads(gzip.decompress((DEST/'source-spl2.json.gz').read_bytes()))
package=json.loads(gzip.decompress((DEST/'package.json.gz').read_bytes()))
corpus_counts={}
for name,surface in [('source',source),('installed_wheel',package['spl2_surface_evidence']),('rebuilt_sdist',package['rebuilt_sdist']['spl2_surface_evidence'])]:
    assert len(surface['corpus'])==1714
    assert {x['id'] for x in surface['corpus']}==set(reports)
    for entry in surface['corpus']:
        for channel in ('native','cli','http'):assert entry[channel]==reports[entry['id']],(name,entry['id'],channel)
    assert surface['go_transport']['sha256']==v['corpus_delta']['actual_transport_sha256']
    corpus_counts[name]={'records':1714,'full_reports_compared':5142}
for p,h in v['tool_and_artifact_identities']['protected_continuity'].items():assert sha((ROOT/p).read_bytes())==h,p
for p,h in v['source_identity']['owned_source_hashes'].items():
    assert sha((ROOT/p).read_bytes())==h
    assert sha(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',v['implementation_commit']+':'+p]))==h
for p,want in v['tool_and_artifact_identities']['artifacts'].items():assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==want['sha256']
record={'kind':'data-only final artifact integrity and exact committed-source reconciliation; no new runtime/conformance credit','implementation_commit':v['implementation_commit'],'verification_sha256':sha((DEST/'verification.json').read_bytes()),'helper_sha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),'helper_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'evidence_artifacts':v['evidence_artifacts'],'execution_archive_files':len(found),'protected_unchanged':len(v['tool_and_artifact_identities']['protected_continuity']),'committed_source_blobs':len(v['source_identity']['owned_source_hashes']),'full_corpus_parity':corpus_counts,'build_artifacts_unchanged':True,'result':'pass'}
with (DEST/'artifact-validation.json').open('x') as out:json.dump(record,out,indent=2);out.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('result','execution_archive_files','protected_unchanged','committed_source_blobs','full_corpus_parity')}))
